# BeatGig — account brief

## Who
BeatGig is a live music booking platform connecting artists with venues, colleges, and private events ([source](https://beatgig.com/)). Its GitHub org lists beatgig.com as its site ([source](https://github.com/beatgig)).

## Production Expo signals
- `eas.json` is present in `beatgig/beatgig-mobile` ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/eas.json)).
- The app's `package.json` pins react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/package.json)).
- `beatgig/beatgig-mobile` was last pushed 2026-06-30 ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile)).
- The org has 6 public repos and 22 followers ([source](https://github.com/beatgig)).
- The iOS app has 1,800 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972)).
- There were 2 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972)).

## Who to talk to
- Maintainer One (@beatgig-maintainer-1), top contributor to `beatgig/beatgig-mobile` with 88 commits ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-1)). Their profile lists company "BeatGig", location "Remote", website https://beatgig.com, and the bio "Mobile engineer at BeatGig. Maintains the BeatGig app (Expo / React Native)." ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-1)).
- Maintainer Two (@beatgig-maintainer-2), contributor to `beatgig/beatgig-mobile` with 19 commits ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-2)). Their profile lists company "BeatGig", location "New York, NY", website https://beatgig.com, and the bio "React Native developer on the BeatGig mobile team. EAS builds and releases for the BeatGig app." ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-2)).

## Why now
The mobile repo was last pushed 2026-06-30 and shipped 2 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile), [source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972)). It runs react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener
Maintainer One, your profile says you maintain the BeatGig app on Expo and React Native, and you have 88 commits to `beatgig/beatgig-mobile` ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-1)). The repo has an `eas.json` and shipped 2 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/eas.json), [source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972)). When you cut those releases, what part of the build and submit path are you still running by hand?
